roadmap.title: Starter unlocks
roadmap.description: Pick up the early quests: raise tomes, break pots, buy chests, and hit the first kill counts on Forest.

roadmap.title: Characters, weapons and tomes via kill counts
roadmap.description: Work through kill-count and weapon-use goals that unlock characters, weapons and tomes.

roadmap.title: Forest and Desert tiers, quests and challenges
roadmap.description: Clear tiers 1-3 on Forest and Desert, finish quests for shop slots, and build up the Challenge count.

roadmap.title: Hidden finds and interactables
roadmap.description: Find hidden items, shrines, boomboxes, frogs and secrets on the Forest and Desert maps.

roadmap.title: Build-based and boss goals
roadmap.description: Run specific builds and restrictions: no-damage boss kills, fast kills, tome level goals and special characters.

roadmap.title: Graveyard map
roadmap.description: Unlock the Graveyard and finish its secrets, crypt goals and boss achievements.

roadmap.title: Hats and long grinds
roadmap.description: Earn the hat achievements, including Rank 100, shop purchases and 100,000-kill Forest runs.

achievements.summary: Raise the Cooldown Tome to level 5.

steps.text: Take @item{Cooldown Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 5.

achievements.description: Defeat a Stage Boss in under 30 seconds
achievements.summary: Defeat a Stage Boss within 30 seconds of its spawning.

steps.text: Kill the Stage Boss within 30 seconds of its spawning, using your full damage output.

achievements.description: Kill 100 cactus enemies with Thorns damage
achievements.summary: Defeat 100 cactus enemies by dealing Thorns damage to them.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} on Tier 1 with the Hyper challenge as Athena or Bush, and take the @item{Thorns Tome} when it is offered.
Let cactus enemies touch or hit you so Thorns damage kills them, and keep weapon hits off them, until 100 have died to Thorns.
Restart the run if no cactus enemy has appeared by the first swarm.

achievements.summary: Die 10 times.

steps.text: Play runs and die; each death counts toward 10.

achievements.summary: Land 100 critical hits.

steps.text: Take @item{Precision Tome} upgrades or crit items and keep fighting until you have landed 100 critical hits.

achievements.summary: Reach 5,000 kills with the Sword weapon.

steps.text: Play as Sir Oofie, who starts with the @item{Sword}, and fight with the Sword until 5,000 kills are done.

achievements.description: Survive the Final Swarm for 2 minues
achievements.summary: Stay alive for 2 minutes once the Final Swarm begins.

steps.text: Build to cut contact damage with armor, evasion, Aegis and lifesteal rather than damage.
Try this on stage 3. The Final Swarm starts when the stage timer reaches zero or the Stage Boss dies.
Press yourself into a corner so enemies reach you from fewer sides, and last 2 minutes.

achievements.summary: Complete 3 Challenges.

steps.text: Pick easy @mechanic{Challenges} such as Fragile or Speedrunner on Forest Tier 1 and finish three of them.

achievements.summary: Stay alive for 60 seconds once the Final Swarm begins.

steps.text: Build to cut contact damage with armor, evasion, Aegis and lifesteal; Final Swarm enemies deal only contact damage.
Start the Final Swarm by letting the stage timer reach zero or by killing the Stage Boss, then last 60 seconds.

achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with the Frostwalker.

steps.text: Take @item{Frostwalker} when level-up offers it and keep fighting enemies near you until 50 have died to it.

achievements.summary: Purchase 25 chests.

steps.text: Buy chests during runs until 25 are bought.

achievements.summary: Reach 40% Difficulty in a run.

steps.text: Pick a quick character and toggle off the tomes and weapons you do not need, so you reach high levels fast.
Gain XP quickly and raise Difficulty with @item{Cursed Tome} levels and difficulty shrines until the stat shows 40%. The same run can also earn Cursed Gloves.

achievements.summary: Defeat a Miniboss within 25 seconds.

steps.text: Find a miniboss, such as Chunkham on Forest, and kill it within 25 seconds.

achievements.summary: Raise the Agility Tome to level 5.

steps.text: Take @item{Agility Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 5.

achievements.summary: Heal a total of 350 HP using Lifesteal.

steps.text: Get lifesteal from @item{Bloody Tome} (unlocked by killing 12,500 enemies) or by playing as Vlad (unlocked by completing Desert Tier 2), and keep hitting enemies until 350 HP has been healed.

achievements.description: Increase Max HP with Blood Magic 400 times
achievements.summary: Increase Max HP 400 times with Blood Magic.

steps.text: Use @item{Blood Magic} as your main weapon and keep killing enemies; each Blood Magic max-HP gain counts toward 400.

achievements.summary: Raise the XP Tome to level 8.

steps.text: Take @item{XP Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 8.

achievements.summary: Break 150 pots.

steps.text: Break every pot you pass during runs until 150 are broken.

achievements.summary: Kill 500 enemies while standing still.

steps.text: Stand still and let your weapons kill enemies until 500 kills are done; only kills made while standing still count.

achievements.description: Obtain 3 Leeching Crystal in a run
achievements.summary: Obtain 3 Leeching Crystals in a single run.

steps.text: Pick up every @item{Leeching Crystal} you find.

Use a blue Microwave on a Rare item you own to duplicate it; if you only have one or two crystals, duplicate a crystal. Each use also removes one of your other Rare items, so keep a separate Rare item to give up each time.
If the crystals do not show up, play more runs; each run gives another chance.

achievements.summary: Raise the Regen Tome to level 8.

steps.text: Take @item{Regen Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 8.

achievements.description: Use a Microwave to duplicate Moldy Cheese 3 times in a row
achievements.summary: Duplicate Moldy Cheese three times in a row with a Microwave.

steps.text: Keep @item{Moldy Cheese} and three other Common items.
Find a white Microwave and use it three times in a row on Moldy Cheese.

achievements.description: Get the Cursed Tome to level 10
achievements.summary: Raise the Cursed Tome to level 10.

steps.text: Toggle off unneeded tomes and weapons, then pick @item{Cursed Tome} every level-up it appears until it reaches level 10.

achievements.summary: Reach level 30 as Calcium.

steps.text: Select Calcium and level up with @item{XP Tome} upgrades until you reach level 30.

achievements.summary: Kill 10,000 enemies as Birdo.

steps.text: Select Birdo and fight with his @item{Tornado} until 10,000 kills are done.

achievements.description: Defeat a Stage Boss with less than 10% HP left
achievements.summary: Defeat a Stage Boss while below 10% of your max HP.

steps.text: Before the boss fight, drop your HP below 10% of max by falling off a cliff again and again, and avoid regen and lifesteal so it stays low.
Stack damage; high damage matters more than a big HP total. Shields are fine, since only HP counts.
Kill the Stage Boss without letting your HP rise above 10%.

achievements.summary: Kill 5,000 enemies as Amog.

steps.text: Select Amog and fight until 5,000 kills are done.

achievements.description: Kill 3 000 enemies using the Sniper Rifle
achievements.summary: Kill 3,000 enemies with the Sniper Rifle.

steps.text: Take @item{Sniper Rifle} when level-up offers it and keep it as your main weapon until 3,000 kills are done.

achievements.summary: Raise the Attraction Tome to level 8.

steps.text: Take @item{Attraction Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 8.

achievements.summary: Kill 5,000 enemies using Rockets.

steps.text: Take @item{Slutty Rocket} when level-up offers it and keep it as your main weapon until 5,000 kills are done.

achievements.summary: Get 2,000 kills with Poison damage.

steps.text: Use poison sources such as @item{Moldy Cheese} and keep fighting until 2,000 enemies die to poison.

achievements.description: Upgrade both Cooldown and Agility Tome to level 5 in a run
achievements.summary: In a single run, raise the Cooldown Tome and also the Agility Tome to level 5.

steps.text: Take @item{Cooldown Tome} and @item{Agility Tome} on level-up until both are level 5 in the same run.

achievements.summary: Reach level 50 as Vlad.

steps.text: Select Vlad, who starts with @item{Blood Magic}, and level up with @item{XP Tome} upgrades until you reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Raise your Max HP to 500.

steps.text: Stack @item{HP Tome} levels and max-HP items such as Oats until your Max HP reaches 500.

achievements.summary: Get 4,000 kills with Fire damage.

steps.text: Play as Fox, who starts with the @item{Firestaff}, and keep using fire weapons until 4,000 kills are done.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Final Boss 2 times.

steps.text: Prepare for the boss fight: get shields, 2 or more extra jumps and good movement speed, and spread your upgrades evenly over all your weapons.
Reach the final boss on a Tier 3 run, preferably on @loc{Forest}, and beat it.
Beat the final boss a second time.

achievements.description: Kill a first Stage Boss without taking any damage that run
achievements.summary: Defeat the first Stage Boss of a run without being hurt at any point.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest} on Tier 1 and finish the Fragile challenge by defeating the first Stage Boss without being damaged; this also unlocks this achievement.
Slide before landing on slopes to avoid fall damage.
Use ranged weapons, toggle off Kevin in the toggler, and skip HP, shield and lifesteal upgrades. Kill the boss without being hit.

achievements.summary: Get 10,000 kills with the Dexecutioner.

steps.text: Take @item{Dexecutioner} when level-up offers it, level it up, and keep it as your main weapon until 10,000 kills are done.

achievements.summary: Get 3,000 kills with Lightning damage.

steps.text: Use the @item{Lightning Staff} and keep it as your main weapon until 3,000 kills are done.

achievements.description: Survive the Final Swarm for 6 minutes
achievements.summary: Stay alive for 6 minutes once the Final Swarm begins.

steps.text: Build around lifesteal and high Max HP, with armor, evasion and Aegis for extra protection.
Try this on stage 3. The Final Swarm starts when the stage timer reaches zero or the Stage Boss dies.
Stay in a corner so your weapons keep hitting and lifesteal keeps healing you, keep enough HP that one hit cannot kill you, and last 6 minutes.

achievements.description: Complete a stage with at least 2 Boss Curse activated
achievements.summary: Finish a stage after activating 2 or more Boss Curse shrines.

steps.text: Activate two or more Boss Curse shrines on a stage.
Defeat every boss that spawns and finish the stage.

achievements.description: Complete every single Charge Shrine on the map
achievements.summary: Charge every Charge Shrine on a single map.

steps.text: Enable the shrine counter option in the settings.
Charge each Charge Shrine on the map; there are 15 per map.
Banish @item{Beacon} if offered, since it adds shrines.

achievements.summary: Poison 50,000 enemies using Moldy Cheese.

steps.text: Pick @item{Moldy Cheese} early and stack it, and keep fighting runs until 50,000 enemies have been poisoned.

achievements.description: Get the Thorns Tome to level 9
achievements.summary: Raise the Thorns Tome to level 9.

steps.text: Take @item{Thorns Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 9.

achievements.description: Find and defeat Bandit in the Desert
achievements.summary: Locate and defeat Bandit on the Desert map.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} Stage 1, find Bandit and defeat him.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies using the Tornado weapon while carried by a tornado on Desert
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with the Tornado weapon while a tornado is carrying you on Desert.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert}, where tornadoes appear, with the @item{Tornado} weapon equipped.
Kill enemies with Tornado while a tornado is carrying you until 100 kills are done.

achievements.description: Find and defeat Bush in the Forest
achievements.summary: Locate and defeat Bush on the Forest map.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest} Stage 1, find Bush and defeat him.

achievements.summary: Kill 1,000 Skeletons.

steps.text: Fight Skeleton enemies and keep killing them until 1,000 are dead.

achievements.summary: Complete Forest Tier 3.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest} on Tier 3 through all stages and beat the final boss.
Use shields, extra jumps and speed to survive the final boss.

achievements.summary: Complete Forest Tier 1.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest} on Tier 1 and complete the tier.

achievements.summary: Complete 100 quests.

steps.text: Keep unlocking weapons, tomes, items and characters until 100 quests are done.

achievements.description: Get the Damage Tome to Level 7
achievements.summary: Raise the Damage Tome to level 7.

steps.text: Take @item{Damage Tome} every time level-up offers it until it reaches level 7.

achievements.description: Find and release Monke in the Forest
achievements.summary: Locate Monke on the Forest map and free him.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest}, find the cage and the key that opens it, and open the cage.

achievements.summary: Complete Desert Tier 1.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} on Tier 1 and complete the tier.

achievements.description: Use a Microwave to duplicate Ice Crystal 3 times in a row
achievements.summary: Duplicate Ice Crystal three times in a row with a Microwave.

steps.text: Unlock @item{Ice Crystal} and turn it on in the toggler so it can appear, then keep it and three other Common items.
Find a white Microwave and use it three times in a row on Ice Crystal; the same Microwave can be used three times.

achievements.summary: Kill 15,000 Goblins.

steps.text: Fight Goblin enemies and keep killing them until 15,000 are dead.

achievements.summary: Complete Forest Tier 2.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest} on Tier 2 and complete the tier.

achievements.summary: Complete 6 Challenges.

steps.text: Pick @mechanic{Challenges} you can finish quickly on Forest and Desert and finish six of them.

achievements.summary: Complete 2 Challenges.

steps.text: Pick easy @mechanic{Challenges} such as Fragile on Forest Tier 1 and finish two of them.

achievements.summary: Complete Desert Tier 2.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} on Tier 2 and complete the tier.

achievements.summary: Get 5,000 kills as Sir Oofie.

steps.text: Play as Sir Oofie and fight until 5,000 kills are done.

achievements.summary: Activate Shrine of Succ 8 times.

steps.text: Use every @mechanic{Shrine of Succ} you find on Desert, Forest or Graveyard until you have used it 8 times.

achievements.summary: Kill 12,500 enemies.

steps.text: Keep fighting runs with any weapon until 12,500 kills are done.

achievements.description: Charge every Charge Shrine on a Tier 3 run across all 3 stages without leaving the charge zone
achievements.summary: Charge every Charge Shrine across all 3 stages of a Tier 3 run without leaving the charge zone.

steps.text: Enable the shrine counter option in the settings.
Banish @item{Beacon} if offered, since it adds shrines.
Charge each shrine fully on every stage and stay inside the charge zone until it finishes; do not outrun the charge, because stepping out of the zone fails the whole attempt.

achievements.description: Beat the Stage Boss in under 5 minutes
achievements.summary: Defeat the Stage Boss within 5 minutes.

steps.text: Clear another Forest Tier 1 challenge first (for example Fragile), which unlocks the Speedrunner+ challenge.
Play @loc{Forest} on Tier 1 with the Speedrunner+ challenge.
Defeat the Stage Boss before 5 minutes pass.

achievements.summary: Upgrade the Axe to level 10.

steps.text: Take @item{Axe} when level-up offers it and choose its upgrades until it is level 10.

achievements.description: 0.01% chance to drop when killing an enemy
achievements.summary: Kill enemies until the Luck Tome drops, which has a 0.01% chance per kill.

steps.text: Kill as many enemies as you can, across as many runs as it takes.
Pick up the Luck Tome when it drops.

achievements.summary: Fire 5,000 projectiles.

steps.text: Use projectile weapons and keep playing runs until 5,000 projectiles are fired.

achievements.summary: Block 250 attacks with Aegis.

steps.text: Take @item{Aegis} when level-up offers it and keep it as a main weapon until it has blocked 250 attacks.

achievements.description: Break 20 pots in a single run
achievements.summary: Break 20 pots during one run.

steps.text: Break every pot you find until 20 are broken.

achievements.description: Block 500 damage with Armor as Sir Oofie
achievements.summary: As Sir Oofie, have your Armor absorb a total of 500 damage.

steps.text: Play as Sir Oofie, whose passive adds Armor with every level, and keep playing runs until Armor has blocked 500 damage in total.

achievements.description: Don't take any damage for 2 minutes
achievements.summary: Go 2 minutes in a run without taking any damage.

steps.text: Start a run and avoid every hit for 2 minutes in a row.

achievements.summary: Defeat 2,000 enemies with the Sword weapon.

steps.text: Play as Sir Oofie, who starts with the @item{Sword}, and keep killing with it until you reach 2,000 kills.

achievements.summary: Find and touch the hidden Shiny Banana.

steps.text: Explore the maps during runs until you find the Shiny Banana, then touch it. It still counts when your weapon slots are full.

achievements.summary: Raise the Knockback Tome to level 10 during a run.

steps.text: Take the @item{Knockback Tome} every time it is offered when you level up, until it reaches level 10.
If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, use it to switch off tomes and weapons you do not need, so the @item{Knockback Tome} shows up more often.

achievements.description: Get the Bloody Tome to Level 12
achievements.summary: Raise the Bloody Tome to level 12 during a run.

steps.text: Take the @item{Bloody Tome} every time it is offered when you level up, until it reaches level 12.
If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, use it to switch off tomes and weapons you do not need, so the @item{Bloody Tome} shows up more often.

achievements.description: Get Cursed Tome to Level 20 in under 10 minutes
achievements.summary: Raise the Cursed Tome to level 20 within the first 10 minutes of a run.

steps.text: Use the @item{Toggler} to switch off unlocked tomes and weapons you do not need, so the Cursed Tome shows up more often.
Play a fast character with a strong XP source, take the Cursed Tome at every offer and refresh poor offers.
Restart the run if the Cursed Tome does not show up early, because level 20 must be reached before the 10-minute mark.

achievements.summary: Defeat 12,500 enemies with the Sword weapon.

steps.text: Play as Sir Oofie, who starts with the @item{Sword}, and keep killing with it until you reach 12,500 kills.

achievements.summary: Get the Luck Tome to level 12.

steps.text: Take the Luck Tome every time it is offered when you level up, until it reaches level 12.
If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, use it to switch off unlocked tomes and weapons you do not need, so the Luck Tome shows up more often.

achievements.description: Kill 1 000 Wisps as Fox on Desert
achievements.summary: As Fox on Desert, defeat 1,000 Wisps.

steps.text: Play as Fox on @loc{Desert} and keep killing Wisps until you reach 1,000 Wisp kills.

achievements.description: Freeze 1 000 enemies with the Ice Cube
achievements.summary: Use the Ice Cube to freeze a total of 1,000 enemies.

steps.text: Find the Ice Cube in a run, for example from chests, and keep it in your build.
Keep playing with the Ice Cube until it has frozen 1,000 enemies.

achievements.description: Defeat a Stage Boss without picking up any items, powerups or using shrines.
achievements.summary: Beat a Stage Boss while collecting no items or powerups and activating no shrines.

steps.text: Unlock the weapon and tome slots and the level-up refresh first, then use the @item{Toggler} to switch off short-range weapons.
Start a run on @loc{Forest} and gain XP only from enemies; ranged weapons and the XP Tome help. Doing the Sticks and stones challenge on Tier 1 removes chest drops.
Pick up only XP and gold, and charge no shrines. @warn{Picking up any other drop, including chests, means you must restart.}
Fight the swarms away from the boss altar so powerups do not land near it, then kill the Stage Boss.

achievements.description: 5% chance to find upon breaking a Tumbleweed on Desert Stage 1
achievements.summary: Find the Katana, which has a 5% chance to drop when you break a Tumbleweed on Desert Stage 1.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} and break every Tumbleweed on Stage 1.
Restart or repeat until the Katana drops. It is collected even when your weapon slots are full.

achievements.summary: Kill 7,500 enemies using Rockets, from either the Slutty Rocket or the Slutty Cannon.

steps.text: Take the @item{Slutty Rocket} in your runs and keep killing with it until you reach 7,500 kills. Kills from the Slutty Cannon count toward the same total.

achievements.summary: Kill the Desert miniboss Scorpionussy 3 times.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} and defeat @enemy{Scorpionussy} whenever it appears.
Repeat in further runs until you have killed it 3 times.

achievements.summary: Kill 7,500 enemies.

steps.text: Play runs on any map and keep killing enemies until the total reaches 7,500.

achievements.description: 5% chance to find upon breaking a Tumbleweed on Desert Stage 2
achievements.summary: Find the Shotgun, which has a 5% chance to drop when you break a Tumbleweed on Desert Stage 2.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} until you reach Stage 2, then break every Tumbleweed there.
Repeat in further runs until the Shotgun drops. It is collected even when your weapon slots are full.

achievements.summary: Kill 15,000 enemies as CL4NK.

steps.text: Play as CL4NK and keep killing enemies until you reach 15,000 kills.

achievements.summary: Raise the Precision Tome to level 10 during a run.

steps.text: Take the @item{Precision Tome} every time it is offered when you level up, until it reaches level 10.
If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, use it to switch off tomes and weapons you do not need, so the @item{Precision Tome} shows up more often.

achievements.description: Complete Desert Tier 2 as Tony McZoom
achievements.summary: As Tony McZoom, clear Desert Tier 2.

steps.text: Play as Tony McZoom on @loc{Desert} Tier 2 and complete the tier.

achievements.description: Charge a total of 5 Charge Shrines during Sandstorms on Desert
achievements.summary: On Desert, charge 5 Charge Shrines in total while a Sandstorm is active.

steps.text: Play @loc{Desert} and watch for a Sandstorm.
Charge a Charge Shrine while the Sandstorm is active. Repeat across runs until 5 are charged.

achievements.description: Get the Lightning Staff to Level 15
achievements.summary: Raise the Lightning Staff to level 15 during a run.

steps.text: Take @item{Lightning Staff} upgrades every time they are offered when you level up, until it reaches level 15.
If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, use it to switch off weapons and tomes you do not need, so @item{Lightning Staff} upgrades show up more often.

achievements.summary: Complete 40 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 40 are done.

achievements.description: Find and activate all the boomboxes on Forest
achievements.summary: Locate every boombox on Forest and activate each one.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Forest} and interact with every Boombox you find.

achievements.description: Teleport to the 2nd stage on Forest Tier 2 as CL4NK
achievements.summary: Teleport to the second stage of Forest Tier 2 as CL4NK.

steps.text: Start a @loc{Forest} Tier 2 run as CL4NK and play until you teleport to Stage 2.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 20 are done.

achievements.summary: Complete 30 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 30 are done.

achievements.summary: Buy 40 unlocks from the shop.

steps.text: Spend your Silver in the unlock shop until you have bought 40 unlocks.

achievements.summary: Complete 35 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 35 are done.

achievements.summary: Complete 25 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 25 are done.

achievements.summary: Complete 45 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 45 are done.

achievements.summary: Complete 55 quests.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{Quests} by meeting their unlock goals until 55 are done.

achievements.description: Defeat a Stage Boss as Athena, landing the killing blow with Aegis
achievements.summary: Kill a Stage Boss as Athena with the final hit coming from Aegis.

steps.text: Play as Athena, who starts with @item{Aegis}. In the shop, refund both extra weapon slots so only Aegis remains, or keep one manually aimed weapon such as @item{Sniper Rifle} or @item{Shotgun} and aim it away from the boss.
Kill each swarm close to the Stage Boss altar so powerups like Time Stop, Nuke and Rage drop near the boss.
Wear the boss down with those powerups and make sure the final hit is an Aegis hit.

achievements.description: Avoid taking fall damage 10 times by hugging walls.
achievements.summary: Hug walls to avoid fall damage 10 times.

steps.text: Fall from a height while pressing against a wall so you land without taking fall damage.
Repeat until you have done it 10 times.

achievements.summary: Complete 5 Challenges.

steps.text: Pick @mechanic{Challenges} on Forest or Desert and clear them until 5 are completed in total.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 Challenges.

steps.text: Clear more @mechanic{Challenges} until 10 are completed in total.

achievements.summary: Complete 20 Challenges.

steps.text: Clear more @mechanic{Challenges} until 20 are completed in total. On Forest Tier 1, you can finish Sticks and stones in the same run as a Hero Sword attempt, because it only turns chests off.

achievements.summary: Complete 30 Challenges.

steps.text: Clear more @mechanic{Challenges}, using @loc{Forest}, @loc{Desert} and @loc{Graveyard}, until 30 are completed in total.

achievements.description: As Calcium on Desert Tier 2, summon and defeat the undead boss
achievements.summary: As Calcium, start on Desert Tier 2, then summon the undead boss and kill it.

guide.context: Calcium must be unlocked and Desert Tier 2 must be available to select.

steps.text: Start @loc{Desert} Tier 2 and play as Calcium.
Find the black grave structure on the map and activate it, then defeat the white ghost that appears.
Follow the question mark on the map to the next grave, activate it and defeat that ghost. Repeat for the black, purple and red ghosts.
Activate the last grave to summon the undead boss and defeat it. The Graveyard unlocks as soon as it dies, so you do not need to finish the run.

achievements.summary: Kill Big Bob on Graveyard.

steps.text: On @loc{Graveyard}, escape the first Crypt. Open each of the four red-beam coffins, kill the guardian ghost it summons, then pick up the Crypt Key; a missed key keeps the Crypt Door shut. Then clear the second Crypt through the Crypt Door.
Fight Big Bob and charge a lamp before his lethal attack so you can stand inside its protection when it lands.
Keep moving between lamps while you damage him until he dies.

achievements.summary: Kill Spooky Steve.

steps.text: Unlock both extra weapon slots first so you can hold four weapons. Play @loc{Graveyard} as Athena and use only @item{Aegis}, @item{Dexecutioner}, @item{Frostwalker} and @item{Black Hole}; if you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, switch off the other weapons in it.
Take the Quantity, Cooldown, Duration and XP Tomes, and use gravestones and boss curses to gain XP.
Wait for Spooky Steve to appear after a Crypt timer ends, ideally in the second Crypt before Big Bob, then slow him with Frostwalker and hold him with Black Hole while Dexecutioner executes him.

achievements.summary: Find the Old Mask on Graveyard.

steps.text: Explore @loc{Graveyard} and climb to the top of a tall tower. Every tower holds an Old Mask.
Use Monke if you have him, because he can climb walls.

achievements.description: As Roberto, break every pumpkin on Graveyard
achievements.summary: Smash every pumpkin on Graveyard while playing as Roberto.

steps.text: Play @loc{Graveyard} as Roberto and enable the shrine counter in settings, so you can see how many pumpkins remain.
Clear the map in sections, following the white dots on the minimap or the full map, and break every pumpkin.

achievements.description: Kill Big Bob on Graveyard using damage from charging a lamp as the finishing blow
achievements.summary: Land the last hit on Big Bob on Graveyard with damage caused by charging a lamp.

steps.text: Play as Athena with @item{Aegis}, one small short-range weapon and the extra weapon slots refunded, so lamps are Big Bob's main source of damage.
Take Regen, Cooldown, Evasion and Quantity Tomes and at least one extra jump, and avoid the movement-speed penalty from a Shrine of Balance.
Reach Big Bob, run from lamp to lamp while dodging, and charge a lamp when he is almost dead so the lamp deals the final damage.

achievements.description: Discover in the secret room in the crypt on Graveyard
achievements.summary: Discover Snek in the secret room of the first Crypt on Graveyard.

steps.text: In the first Crypt on @loc{Graveyard}, look for the room that has a central pillar and two jump pads, then drop to its lower platform.
Step on the pressure plate and listen for a door opening. A tunnel opens in the lava wall across the room.
Cross the lava to the passage and jump up into the secret chamber before the lava kills you. Restart if the room does not appear.

achievements.description: Open every chest and pot in the first crypt on Graveyard
achievements.summary: Open all chests and pots in the first Crypt on Graveyard.

steps.text: In the first Crypt on @loc{Graveyard}, run through the whole route and open every chest and break every pot before the Crypt timer runs out. Plan the route so nothing is left behind.
Check the minimap for dots you left behind. Jump next to a wall to open chests from below while still in the air.

achievements.description: As Vlad, use Pot (stainless steel) to upgrade any weapon above its max level of 40
achievements.summary: Playing as Vlad, push a weapon past its level cap of 40 by using Pot (stainless steel).

steps.text: Play @loc{Graveyard} as Vlad with one weapon you want to level and the XP, Luck, Quantity and Cooldown Tomes. Use the @item{Toggler} to switch off other legendary items.
Pop gravestones for XP and use several boss curses so the weak key ghosts drop chests, then open the chests with high Luck until @item{Pot (stainless steel)} drops.
Level your chosen weapon past 40 with the XP Tome and use Pot on it.

achievements.description: Open the present hidden on Forest
achievements.summary: Open the present hidden on Forest.

steps.text: Start a @loc{Forest} run on Stage 1, look for a red present box and open it.

achievements.description: As Amog, defeat a Tier 3 final boss with 8 Moldy Cheese and 1 Snek in your inventory
achievements.summary: As Amog, beat a Tier 3 final boss while holding 8 Moldy Cheese and 1 Snek.

steps.text: If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, switch off nearly all other items in it so Moldy Cheese appears more often.

In a run as Amog, collect 8 Moldy Cheese and find Snek, an item you must unlock first. Gather @item{Key}s by duplicating them with microwaves, breaking pots and buying from Shady Guys, avoid Greed shrines, then spend the Keys on chests to find Moldy Cheese and Snek.
Fight the Tier 3 final boss with everything in your inventory. Extra jumps, extra speed, many projectiles and Aegis shields all help.

achievements.description: As Athena, kill 500 enemies using Quin's Mask
achievements.summary: As Athena, get 500 kills with Quin's Mask.

steps.text: Play as Athena with Quin's Mask and build Thorns, for example with the Thorns Tome.
Let enemies touch you and die to Thorns damage, aiming your weapons away from them, until 500 kills come from Quin's Mask.

achievements.description: Get a gold star on every character (Rank 100)
achievements.summary: Get a gold star (Rank 100) on every character.

steps.text: Unlock every character and play each of them until it reaches Rank 100 and shows a gold star.
Keep rotating through characters until none are left below Rank 100.

achievements.description: Find the frogs on Forest Stage 1
achievements.summary: Find and kill the frogs on Forest Stage 1.

steps.text: On @loc{Forest} Stage 1, find the egg and activate it so it bursts into three frogs.
Kill all three frogs. Do it later in the run when your damage is high, because they run around the map.

achievements.description: Find the frogs on Forest Stage 2
achievements.summary: Find and kill the frogs on Forest Stage 2.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Forest} Stage 2, find the egg and activate it so it bursts into three frogs.
Kill all three frogs, ideally later in the stage when your damage is high.

achievements.description: Find the frogs on Forest Stage 3
achievements.summary: Find and kill the frogs on Forest Stage 3.

steps.text: Reach @loc{Forest} Stage 3, find the egg and activate it so it bursts into three frogs.
Kill all three frogs, ideally later in the stage when your damage is high.

achievements.description: As Ninja, complete Desert Stage 1 with at least 2 Boss Curse shrines activated
achievements.summary: As Ninja, clear Desert Stage 1 with 2 or more Boss Curse shrines active.

steps.text: Play as Ninja on @loc{Desert} and restart until the Stage 1 map has at least 2 Boss Curse shrines.
Activate 2 Boss Curse shrines early. Each one adds a boss, so expect several bosses at the end of the stage.
Complete Stage 1 with both curses active.

achievements.summary: Take 100,000 punches from Kevin.

steps.text: Pick up Kevin in your runs and keep him for the whole run.
Use shields or lifesteal to survive his punches and play on until the punch total reaches 100,000.

achievements.description: As Fox, get Firestaff, Lightning Staff & Blood Magic to level 40
achievements.summary: As Fox, bring Blood Magic, Firestaff and Lightning Staff all to level 40.

steps.text: Unlock the extra weapon slot, play as Fox and take the @item{Firestaff}, @item{Lightning Staff} and @item{Blood Magic}. If you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, use it to switch off other weapons.
Take the XP Tome first, then put every weapon upgrade into these three until all reach level 40.

achievements.description: As Sir Oofie, defeat the final boss of Forest 3 using Sword, Hero Sword, Corrupted Sword and Scythe
achievements.summary: As Sir Oofie, beat the Forest Tier 3 final boss while using these four weapons: Sword, Scythe, Hero Sword and Corrupted Sword.

steps.text: Unlock both extra weapon slots and the @item{Hero Sword}, @item{Corrupted Sword} and @item{Scythe}, then, if you have unlocked the @item{Toggler}, switch off other weapons in it.
Play @loc{Forest} Tier 3 as Sir Oofie with all four of those weapons, and spread upgrades across them.
Take shields, at least 2 extra jumps and movement speed, then defeat the final boss. The weapons come back to you as its health drops.

achievements.summary: Blow up 50 microwaves.

steps.text: Find and use microwaves in your runs. Forest and Desert have 1 to 2 per map and Graveyard has 3 to 5.
Keep going across runs until 50 have blown up.

achievements.description: As Birdo, kill 1000 enemies using Mines while flying in the air
achievements.summary: As Birdo, use Mines to kill 1,000 enemies while you are flying.

steps.text: Play as Birdo with the @item{Mines} weapon and take the Size, XP, Damage and Quantity Tomes.
Play @loc{Desert} Stage 1 and hold Jump to float. Lead enemies over your mines so they explode while you fly.
Keep going across runs until 1,000 kills come from mines while you are in the air.

achievements.description: As Roberto, obtain 4x Pot (stainless steel) in a single run
achievements.summary: As Roberto, get 4 Pot (stainless steel) items in one run.

steps.text: Play as Roberto and use the @item{Toggler} to switch off other legendary items so Pot is the only legendary that can appear.
Raise Luck, then open as many chests as possible and buy Pot from a yellow-hatted Shady Guy until you hold 4 in one run.

achievements.description: Buy 100 items from a Common Shady Guy
achievements.summary: Buy 100 items from Common Shady Guys.

steps.text: Buy items from every Common Shady Guy you meet in your runs until you have bought 100 in total.
Graveyard has twice as many Shady Guys as the other maps.

achievements.description: Buy 80 items from a Rare Shady Guy
achievements.summary: Buy 80 items from Rare Shady Guys.

steps.text: Buy items from every Rare Shady Guy you meet in your runs until you have bought 80 in total.
Graveyard has twice as many Shady Guys as the other maps.

achievements.description: Buy 60 items from an Epic Shady Guy
achievements.summary: Buy 60 items from Epic Shady Guys.

steps.text: Buy items from every Epic Shady Guy you meet in your runs until you have bought 60 in total.
Graveyard has twice as many Shady Guys as the other maps.

achievements.description: Buy 50 items from a Legendary Shady Guy
achievements.summary: Buy 50 items from Legendary Shady Guys.

steps.text: Buy items from every Legendary Shady Guy you meet in your runs until you have bought 50 in total.
Graveyard has twice as many Shady Guys as the other maps.

achievements.description: As CL4NK, kill any boss or miniboss in under 1 second
achievements.summary: As CL4NK, kill a boss or miniboss within 1 second.

steps.text: Play as CL4NK with a high-burst build until you can one-shot a boss with about 2,000 HP.
Kill a weak boss or miniboss within 1 second of its appearing, for example the first ghost from a Graveyard grave.

achievements.description: As Calcium, finish the final boss fight on Graveyard in under 60 seconds
achievements.summary: As Calcium, defeat the Graveyard final boss within 60 seconds of the fight.

steps.text: Play as Calcium on @loc{Graveyard}, build high damage, then complete the four-key Crypt route.
Charge a lamp for protection against Big Bob's lethal attack and defeat him within 60 seconds of the fight.

achievements.description: Get 100,000 kills on Forest in a single run
achievements.summary: Reach 100,000 kills in one Forest run.

steps.text: Play @loc{Forest} with a build that stacks Luck and XP early. Take the XP Tome, and use the Luck, Chaos and Cursed Tomes too once you have unlocked them.
Keep surviving after the stage timer ends, because the kills keep adding up, until you reach 100,000 in one run.

achievements.description: Get 300,000 kills on Forest in a single run
achievements.summary: Reach 300,000 kills in one Forest run.

steps.text: Use the same Luck and XP build as for Top Hat on @loc{Forest} and survive as long as you can after the timer ends.
Keep killing within one run until you reach 300,000 kills.
